title: E156 Machine-Readable Assertion
description: A nanopublication-style structured assertion paired with an E156 micro-paper. Carries the single named primary estimand as machine-checkable data so the central claim can be verified against the bound dataset independently of the prose body. Three parts mirror the nanopublication model: assertion (the claim), provenance (where it came from), pubinfo (who minted it and under what version).

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema the instance targets.

variant.description: E156 variant type; must match the Outside Note 'Type'.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact 7-sentence body the assertion describes. Binds the assertion to one immutable body; if the body is edited, this no longer matches and the assertion is known-stale.

body_word_count.description: Release mode is exactly 156; drafts may be lower.

assertion.description: The single primary estimand, as data. Exactly one estimand per E156 (the format's hard rule).

estimand_label.description: Human-readable name; must equal Outside Note 'Primary estimand' (e.g. 'Risk ratio for major bleeding').

effect_measure.description: Canonical effect-measure code. Diagnostic variants use sensitivity/specificity/DOR/AUC; prevalence uses proportion; correlation pooling uses r (Fisher-z pooled, back-transformed).

scale.description: Pooling/back-transform scale. Ratio measures (RR/OR/HR/IRR/DOR) are pooled on the log scale; point/ci here are reported on the NATURAL scale after back-transform.

point.description: Back-transformed primary estimate, on the natural scale (e.g. RR 0.49, not log RR).

method.description: CI method (e.g. 'HKSJ-t', 'Wald', 'profile-likelihood'). Optional but recommended for reproducibility.

null_value.description: Value of no effect on the natural scale: 1 for ratio measures, 0 for linear. Used to auto-derive 'significant'.

favours_lower.description: TRUE if a lower value favours the intervention (e.g. RR<1 = less bleeding). Forces the author to state direction explicitly rather than leaving it to prose.

heterogeneity.description: Reported alongside point estimate (advanced-stats.md: I^2 is a proportion, never magnitude — carry tau^2 too).

allOf.$comment: Ratio measures live on the ratio scale, are strictly positive, and have null value 1.
Linear measures live on the linear scale with null value 0.
Correlation r is bounded in [-1,1] on a linear scale with null value 0 (pooled on Fisher-z, reported back-transformed).

provenance.description: Where the number came from. The data binding is what makes the assertion falsifiable.

search_through.description: Last search date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Treat as a typed date, not approximate text (rules.md identifier discipline).

data_binding.description: Hash of the exact study-level rows (yi/sei or 2x2 cells) the estimand was computed from. An auditor recomputes the pool from these rows and checks point/ci match. This is the verifiability layer.

rows_uri.description: Relative path or URL to the bound rows. Relative paths preferred (no hardcoded local paths in shipped assets — rules.md).

source_article.description: Underlying primary publication, when the E156 recasts one. Identifiers are typed and must be DOI/PMID-resolvable before publish (lessons.md citation rule).

version.description: E156 release version (semver), matches Outside Note 'Version'.

certainty.description: GRADE certainty for the primary estimand. Maps to Outside Note 'Certainty'.

validation.description: Body/format validator state. PASS asserts the 7-sentence / <=156-word contract held.

doi.description: DOI of the E156 itself, or null/'pending' if not yet minted.
